clue.text: Region that's Spanish and American, inter alia

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: inter is Latin for between, so the American abbreviation goes between the letters of alia

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A geography note listing a region with Spanish and American connections, among other things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inter alia' reads as the Latin tag for 'among other things', but 'inter' is Latin for between and alia is just fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Andalucia is the large autonomous region of southern Spain, home to Seville and Granada.

clue.text: Engagement ring from one who will care, naturally

indicators.note: from tells us to take the letters out of the run of words that follows, here spanning care and naturally

explanation.surface: A caring person picks out an engagement ring as a natural gesture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engagement ring' looks like jewellery, but the engagement is a fight and the ring is where it happens.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is an enclosed space for contests, a ring where combatants engage one another.

clue.text: See a bishop's concern

definitions.meaning: a see is the area over which a bishop has authority
the district a bishop looks after

explanation.definitionFit: A diocese is the district under a bishop's charge, also called his see.

clue.text: Look round New York — it's crazy!

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
a round shape is the letter O

explanation.surface: A visitor glances around New York and finds the place mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Loony is an informal adjective for someone mad or wildly eccentric.

clue.text: He may have to wait for his money

definitions.text: He may have to wait for his money

parts.words: He may have to wait for his money
parts.note: reads like a creditor kept waiting, but the person waits at table or on an employer and earns wages by it

explanation.surface: Someone owed money has to wait patiently for payment.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic servant or waiter is paid to wait on people, so waiting is his paid work.

clue.text: A drink knocked over ran away swiftly — wasted

indicators.note: a drink knocked over is upended, so in a down clue its letters run the other way

parts.note: port is a fortified wine
hied is an old verb meaning hurried or hastened

explanation.surface: Someone knocks a drink over and bolts, wasted from drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Atrophied means withered or wasted away, as a muscle shrinks from disuse.

clue.text: Moment when these birds became extinct

definitions.text: Moment when these birds became extinct

parts.note: mo is short for a moment, as in 'wait a mo'
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: A natural history question about the time a group of birds died out.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: the birds that became extinct, at a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Moas were huge flightless birds of New Zealand, hunted to extinction centuries ago.

clue.text: Forgets my sails may be badly rigged

indicators.note: sails rigged badly are set up all wrong, so the letters of my sails are rearranged

explanation.surface: A forgetful sailor whose sails end up poorly rigged.
explanation.definitionFit: To mislay something is to forget where it was put, losing it for a while.

clue.text: Leave to enter guilty plea?

definitions.meaning: permission to go into a place
a confession of guilt in court

explanation.definitionFit: Admission is both entry permitted and an acknowledgement of wrongdoing.

clue.text: It's when to start, but nothing's on time

parts.note: zero is nothing, a nil quantity
an hour is a time, as in 'at what hour'

explanation.surface: Something is due to start, yet nothing happens punctually.
explanation.definitionFit: Zero hour is the moment planned for an operation or attack to begin.

clue.text: Right to sue me, perhaps, so start again

indicators.note: perhaps hints that sue me could take another form, so its letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A defiant litigant says you have every right to sue them, so begin again.
explanation.definitionFit: To resume is to carry on after a pause, beginning again where one left off.

clue.text: Thin and pale, we try a doctor

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters of we try a are rearranged

explanation.surface: Feeling thin and pale, the patients decide to see a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like a noun for the medic, but it is a verb meaning tamper.
explanation.definitionFit: Watery describes something weak and diluted, like thin soup or pale sunlight.

clue.text: Value a quiet compliment

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning quietly
praise is a compliment, an expression of approval

explanation.surface: A quiet word of praise shows how much someone is valued.
explanation.definitionFit: To appraise is to assess the worth of something, putting a value on it.

clue.text: Pretend to influence

definitions.meaning: to put on a show of a feeling or manner
to have an effect on something

explanation.definitionFit: Affect means both to feign, as with an affected accent, and to have an effect on.

clue.text: Abandoned type petting outside university

indicators.note: outside says the caressing word goes around the letter for university

parts.note: fondling is petting or caressing

explanation.surface: A dissolute student caught petting just outside the university grounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Abandoned type' suggests a wanton person, but it means one left behind as a baby.
explanation.definitionFit: A foundling is an infant deserted by its parents and found by others.

clue.text: Nursing management

definitions.meaning: medical care given to a patient
the way something is handled or dealt with

explanation.definitionFit: Treatment is the care given to the sick and also the handling of any matter or person.

clue.text: Confusion that doesn't have one's head in a whirl

definitions.text: Confusion that doesn't have one's head in a whirl

parts.words: Confusion that doesn't have one's head in a whirl
parts.note: a state of panic, here pictured as a spin led not by the head but by the other end

explanation.surface: A state of confusion that somehow leaves one's head clear.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailspin is a plane's spiralling dive and, figuratively, a state of panic or chaos.

clue.text: Prepared bean soup served by a court officer

definitions.note: describes a writ, a thing that an officer serves; the answer is that writ

indicators.note: soup prepared is made up from its ingredients, so the letters of bean soup are rearranged

explanation.surface: A court official dishes up a bowl of home-made bean soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served' looks like a waiter's job, but a writ is served on a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A subpoena is a writ ordering someone to attend court, delivered by an officer.

clue.text: A drink or two on the quiet

definitions.text: A drink or two on the quiet

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning quietly

indicators.note: a drink or two suggests the drink appears twice over

parts.note: ale is a drink, a kind of beer

explanation.surface: Someone sneaks a drink or two without anyone noticing.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: P with two ALEs.
explanation.definitionFit: Pale ale is a light-coloured bitter beer, a classic British pub drink.

clue.text: Lamb, say, is perhaps unfathomable

indicators.note: perhaps signals the letters of Lamb say could be arranged differently

explanation.surface: The essayist Charles Lamb, for example, is perhaps hard to understand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lamb' looks like the writer Charles Lamb or a young sheep, but it is only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Abysmal literally means like an abyss, so bottomless or too deep to fathom.

clue.text: Saying when?

parts.note: reads as telling a host to stop pouring, but means stating the time something happened

explanation.surface: A host asks a guest to say when to stop pouring.
explanation.definitionFit: Dating something is fixing when it happened, as with an archaeological find.

clue.text: Stress? One isn't affected

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters of one isn't are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asked about stress, a calm person claims to be untouched by it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tension is mental strain or the pulling force in a stretched cable.

clue.text: Dilatory sort of hero worship

indicators.note: sort of suggests a variant, so the letters of dilatory are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Fans who are slow and lazy indulge in a kind of hero worship.
explanation.definitionFit: Idolatry is the worship of idols and, loosely, excessive adoration of a person.

clue.text: She's seen in a classy French resort at end of June

indicators.note: end of takes just the final letter of June

parts.note: U is the old British label for upper-class, as in U and non-U
Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: A woman is spotted at a smart Riviera resort in late June.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' is a crossword convention for any woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name stands in for the pronoun she, any woman at all.

clue.text: Fear head chopped off in mistake

indicators.note: with its head chopped off the word loses its first letter

parts.note: terror is great fear

explanation.surface: A dread of beheading by mistake, as in a bloody revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: An error is a mistake, something done wrongly.

clue.text: Do impressive work as a huntsman?

definitions.meaning: to engrave or emboss metal, pressing a design into it
to pursue quarry, as a huntsman does

explanation.walkthrough: 'impressive' means making impressions in metal, not admirable.
explanation.definitionFit: To chase is both to hunt and to decorate metal by engraving or embossing.

clue.text: Motorway fury at illusory prospect of refreshment

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI in crosswords
rage is fury

explanation.surface: Road rage on the motorway at the sight of a service station that is not there.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds; its 1 stands in for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: A mirage is an optical illusion, classically of water in the desert to a thirsty traveller.

clue.text: Result of having a crush on sugared almonds

definitions.text: Result of having a crush on sugared almonds

parts.words: Result of having a crush on sugared almonds
parts.note: sounds like an infatuation with sweets, but describes ground almonds mixed with sugar

explanation.surface: Someone with a passion for sugared almonds and its consequences.
explanation.definitionFit: Marzipan is a paste made from crushed almonds and sugar, used on cakes.

clue.text: A complaint I'd not put in a guide

indicators.note: not put in means these letters are left out of the guide

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A grumble someone chose to leave out of their guidebook.
explanation.definitionFit: An ague is a fever with shivering fits, an old word for an illness.

clue.text: Play patience

definitions.meaning: slack or give in a mechanism, allowed movement

explanation.walkthrough: 'Play patience' suggests the card game, but both words are definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolerance is both the permitted margin of movement in engineering and forbearance.
